## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY in RECOVERY (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.96%) while VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +13.23%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +2.73%) show mixed risk signals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear rising: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +13.23%) ↑ rising — cautionary for risk assets. Credit steady: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +0.11%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.22%) show credit stress easing. Commodity/energy lift: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +13.50%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +12.76%) supporting cyclicals.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral overall: Dollar stable (no clear UUP signal in data); TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +2.73%) → flat and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +6.53%) ↑ rising indicate demand for hedges alongside modest rate/fiscal caution.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +12.76%); Healthcare and Staples showing resilience: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +9.30%) and XLP CORRECTION (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +8.14%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -4.39%); style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US mixed: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.96%) vs QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -3.12%) — breadth narrow. EM/Asia uneven: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +5.03%) while EWJ in CORRECTION (1W: -2.62% | 1M: +7.70%) shows rotation.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation cooling: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.21% | 1M: -27.87%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -14.87%) weak; small caps IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -3.45%) also under pressure.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Commodity strength concentrated: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +13.50%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +12.64%) driving reflation tone, CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.34% | 1M: +0.06%) supportive of industrial demand. Gold GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +6.53%) rising as hedge.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy robust: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +12.76%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +13.50%) ↑ rising, while natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.63% | 1M: -12.58%) remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Bonds/hedges — TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +2.73%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +6.53%). DIVERGENCE: Major divergence across core ETFs (SPY RECOVERY vs XLK BELOW TREND vs TLT ABOVE TREND) and narrow breadth (4/11) — suppress strong directional bets.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor exposure to energy/cyclicals showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND, BNO ABOVE TREND) and maintain hedges (TLT ABOVE TREND, GLD ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to speculative/thematic groups (IBIT BELOW TREND, ARKK BELOW TREND) until breadth improves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +12.76%) if BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +13.50%) sustains gains. BEARISH: Technology — XLK (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -4.39%) if QQQ (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -3.12%) continues lower.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Oil — BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +13.50%) for reflation trades. BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: -5.63% | 1M: -12.58%) on weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +13.23%) ~20 (complacency/watch). HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: +0.02% | 1M: +0.11%; LQD 1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.22%) ~0.80 (credit health). XLK (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -4.39%) / SPY (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.96%) watch relative trend cross for leadership signal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, with energy and select defensives showing strength while tech and financials lag. Key risk: major divergence between SPY/XLK/TLT and rising VXX — watch for breadth improvement before adding directional risk.
